$comment: The source of sf-button-icon's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/icon-button (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

kind.summary: What the icon button is: an ordinary icon action or a close control.

appearance.summary: How the icon button looks, one ladder from the strongest (rule C15): default (filled), tonal, outline, ghost (no fill or edge until a pointer or the keyboard reaches it). link is ghost's former name; surface was retired and is drawn as tonal with the on-surface scheme.

scheme.summary: Which colour family the control takes (rule C15): primary, on-surface (the neutral, the text colour) or on-surface-variant (the quiet neutral: a window's head, a table row, a field's clear; under a pointer its glyph darkens to on-surface). A filled (default) control keeps on-surface's inverse glyph with on-surface-variant: on a dark fill there is no quieter step. secondary was retired and is drawn as on-surface-variant. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

status.summary: What the control is about (rule C13): danger, a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone. It paints with the error roles -- the red of an error -- and behaves exactly like a primary control. error is its former name on a control.

segment.summary: Joined-control position owned by Button Group composition.

filled.summary: Use the filled glyph axis for the standard icon variant.

loading.summary: Loading state: the spinner in place of the icon, at the icon's size, in the page's look (data-sf-spinner). Sets aria-busy and disables the native button.

badge-count.summary: A count on the icon button (simai/ui-source#12): a whole number above 0 shows, 0 or empty hides the badge. Above badge-cap it reads «<cap>+»; the exact number joins the icon button's accessible name («Уведомления, 5 непрочитанных») and the badge's tooltip. On an anchor of size 1/3 or 1/2 a count is drawn as a dot.

badge-dot.summary: A dot on the icon button, a count with no number: something new. Shown when badge-count is not set; with a count, the count is drawn as a dot. Its text equivalent («есть новое» / «new» by default, badge-label to change it) joins the accessible name.

badge-cap.summary: The largest count drawn as a number; a larger one reads «<cap>+».

badge-label.summary: The words the badge adds to the accessible name and its tooltip, in place of the page language's default: for a dot the whole text equivalent; for a count the phrase in plural forms separated by «|» (one|few|many in Russian, one|other in English) with {count} where the number goes.

button-attributes.summary: Attributes an external project template may put on its button; the built-in template does not read them

pressed.summary: Whether this toggle button is on: aria-pressed on the native button and the pressed look -- the primary container fill, its ink, no visible edge and the icon filled (rule C12); pressed="false" says off; absent, the button is not a toggle and nothing is said

label-pressed.summary: The accessible name while the toggle is on, for a toggle whose name changes («Добавить в избранное» → «Убрать из избранного»). Set, the name says the state and aria-pressed is not written; the pressed look still follows pressed. Empty: aria-label stays the name and aria-pressed says the state

lang.summary: The language the label is written in (BCP 47).

pressed.summary: Draws this item with the pressed look (the «on» values of repeat); no aria-pressed is said.

cycle.x-shape: ui-source src/smart/helpers/cycle.js cycleItems: the attribute takes JSON or value::label::flags|… (flags icon=<name>, pressed), the property a list; the items are shaped like sf-segmented's items
cycle.summary: One button, several values (rule D11d): the items {value, label, icon, pressed?} a press steps through, wrapping at the end. value is the current item. The name and the icon say the current value («Повтор: один трек»), the tooltip says the current and the next, and a polite live region says the new value after a press; change {previous, value, item} follows. Not a toggle: pressed and label-pressed are ignored beside it, with one console warning.

theme-cycle.summary: A ready theme switch over SF.Loader's theme (the contract of sf-segmented's theme-switch: themePreference, setTheme, sf-theme-change). Present and empty: three values, «as the system», light and dark, in the owner's order -- first the theme opposite to the visible one, then the other, then «as the system» (rule D11d); "light dark": two values, every press flips the visible theme. The icons are contrast, light_mode and dark_mode; the words are the page language's («Тема: светлая. Нажмите — тёмная»). cycle is ignored beside it.

value.summary: The current item of a cycle (its value); a press writes the next one. Read it from the attribute or from change: the value property keeps the settings object it has always given.

item.summary: The item now current: {value, label, icon, lang, pressed}.

change.summary: A cycle (cycle or theme-cycle) moved to its next value after a person's press; dispatched on the host, bubbles and is composed, after press on sf-button. A theme cycle sends it after SF.Loader.setTheme has drawn the theme. Not sent by a button that is not a cycle.

relations.name: badges
$comment: The badge sheet places a count or a dot on the button (simai/ui-source#12).

relations.name: spinner
$comment: The spinner a loading icon button shows, fetched after the page is ready.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

name.$comment: A cycle's name is the aria-label and the current item's label («Повтор: один трек»); a theme cycle without one says «Тема: …» in the page language.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-button-icon for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
the legacy axis name; the shim maps the attribute and the property
rows.summary: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: the legacy axis name; the shim maps the attribute and the property
rows.summary: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: journal attribute-tightness-to-spacing; its words are spacing's value aliases below, spacing wins when both are given
journal value-icon-button-looks-c15 (rule C15): link and ghost drew the same; ghost is the name
journal value-icon-button-looks-c15 (rule C15): secondary was drawn only in the tonal look and read as the quiet neutral elsewhere
journal value-control-status-error-to-danger (rule C13): a control's destructive status is danger; messages keep error

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-button-icon; sf-icon-button is a subclass defined beside it until the date

x-summary: Native icon-only action with token geometry, accessible naming and shared loading semantics.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: a11y-role: button, the native <button> the template draws (the host is display:contents). The name is the host's aria-label, passed to the native button with the badge phrase after it (§3.1, §4.8); an icon-only control has no other text.

key-effects: Tab reach. Enter and Space are the native button's own activation, not an effect of the closed list; the native click bubbles as before. No press event: the parts catalogue gives sf-icon-button none, and sf-button's press is the target the stands wrote for sf-button alone.

setter: setButtonAttributes is not an action (§4.4): button-attributes is a writable object setting (a property), and the method stays a helper that writes it; it no longer writes the object into an attribute.

legacy names: type -> appearance, variant -> kind and tightness -> spacing leave the settings and are dated setting aliases (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01); tightness's words are spacing's value aliases (low/high/highest -> compact/comfortable/spacious). ghost stays an appearance of its own here: the class sf-icon-button--ghost draws it.
badge-cap is a number with min 1; badge-count stays a string capped by badge-cap.
aria-label is a host attribute, never a setting (§3.1); the template reads it from the host.

template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift). The host stays display:contents: geometry lives on > button.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (add, default primary) plus tonal and outline, the close kind, the error status, a count badge, loading, disabled and segments.
css-variables: the seven public variables of src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json the class sheet already reads (§6).

folder: icon-buttons takes the tag's name, icon-button (§3, §21, §16 item 16); the loader bundle is cl-icon-button, cl-icon-buttons is a Loader forward (src/core/contracts/smart-rule-forwards.v1.json) and smart/icon-buttons/js/icon-buttons.js a forwarding script (css/icon-buttons.css its sheet) until 2026-12-01 (change journal path-smart-icon-buttons-to-icon-button). The registry id follows the folder: smart.icon-button (smart.icon-buttons is its dated alias in the same record).
version 1.1.0: renamed members behind dated aliases are a minor (§4.10, §16.20).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0: a minor (§4.10): the scheme value on-surface-variant is added, the same name and the same meaning sf-button 1.2.0 gave it -- the on-surface family one step quieter, the glyph in --sf-on-surface-variant. Until now that grey was reachable only by accident: every pair of appearance and scheme sets --sf-icon--color except the ones nobody wrote a rule for (secondary outside tonal), where the base colour showed through. The element carries sf-icon-button--on-surface beside the new class, so every on-surface rule (fill, edge, states) holds and one rule in the custom sheet quietens the glyph and a close control's cross; a filled control is left alone (:not(--default)).

version 1.3.0: the tag is sf-button-icon (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.button-icon and the bundle cl-button-icon follow it. sf-icon-button stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-button-icon, sf-icon-button) (change journal tag-sf-icon-button-to-sf-button-icon, path-smart-icon-button-to-button-icon).

version 1.4.0: a minor (§4.10): the setting pressed is added (stage 1 of the component sets, duplication audit A-10), as on sf-button: present, aria-pressed on the native button and, while on, the active state of the icon-button class sheet; absent, nothing is said. A page that wrote aria-pressed on the host keeps it.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-06): the host's aria-label is watched, so a name changed after the first drawing reaches the native button (it was patched by updateDom but never observed: sf-language's trigger kept «Язык: Русский» after a choice). Nothing else changes.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-07): a minor (§4.10): the pressed look and the setting label-pressed (owner decision 2026-11-07, docs review R028, rule C12). A toggle that is on wears sf-icon-button--pressed instead of the active class: the primary container fill, no visible edge (the border keeps its width and is transparent over the fill, so the height does not move), the icon in --sf-on-primary-container and filled (FILL 1) -- two cues, not colour alone. Hover and press over it step the container; focus draws the ring; disabled wears the disabled look and keeps the filled icon. Public variables --sf-icon-button-pressed-background-color and --sf-icon-button-pressed-color colour the resting pressed look. label-pressed is the name while on, for a toggle whose name changes: aria-pressed is then not written.

version 1.5.1 (2026-11-07): a loading icon button's spinner draws its ring inside the icon's live area (docs review R027, owner decision C11; component.spinner 1.1.0): 20 of the 24 units, as the Material Symbol beside it, in the same icon box, so nothing around it moves; the first-paint snapshots are retaken. The settings are unchanged.

version 1.5.2 (2026-11-08): the reference describes the current component only (docs review rules D02, D03, msg-4ef7082c): the scheme words no longer cite another component's version and pressed names the rule, not a sheet's version; tightness, type and variant are listed under sf-button-icon in the change journal, so the reference shows them as former names, not as attributes. Tab, Enter and Space are the component's own key map now (they were a registry copy); the manifest lists the same three. Settings, values, events and the drawing are unchanged.

version 1.6.0 (2026-11-08): a minor (§4.10; docs review R031, R033, R039; owner rules C13, C15, D11d). The looks are four without twins: appearance default, tonal, outline, ghost -- link is ghost's dated alias (both drew the same), surface is retired and drawn as tonal with the on-surface scheme unless the page names a scheme (the component reads the word and notes it: it changes two settings, which a value alias cannot); its tonal look also fixes surface with status error, which drew grey. scheme primary, on-surface, on-surface-variant -- secondary is a dated alias of on-surface-variant; a quiet glyph without a fill darkens to on-surface under a pointer. status danger for a control that deletes or cannot be undone, error its dated alias (C13: messages keep error; one red, the error roles); the native button carries sf-icon-button--danger and sf-icon-button--error, which the sheets and their consumers select. ghost is drawn by the link class the sheets already had, so nothing a consumer selects moves. cycle (a list of {value, label, icon, pressed?}), theme-cycle and value: one button, several values (D11d) -- the name and icon say the current value, the title the current and the next, a polite live region the new value; change {previous, value, item}; theme-cycle steps the opposite of the visible theme first, then the other, then «as the system» (contrast icon), or flips two themes. pressed and label-pressed are ignored beside a cycle, with one console warning.
version 1.7.0: one number above the unreleased 1.6.0 (the looks above) and 1.5.3 (a first-paint sheet list patch) it joins; nothing beyond them changes.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-button-icon for a compact action that is unambiguous from one familiar icon and has a concise accessible name.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not omit aria-label when no visible text names the action
Do not use the large-surface radius as a normal control variation
Do not keep a loading action enabled

accessibility.focus: The inner native button is the only focus owner. Pointer activation does not show the ring; keyboard focus uses focus-visible, with an inset ring inside joined controls.

setButtonAttributes.summary: Passes the object to setState() as buttonAttributes; the built-in template does not read it, so it only reaches an external project template. Returns the element.

onClick.summary: Adds a listener for click on the host. Returns the element.

onFocus.summary: Adds a listener for focusin on the host. Returns the element.

onBlur.summary: Adds a listener for focusout on the host. Returns the element.

onMouseEnter.summary: Adds a listener for mouseenter on the host. Returns the element.

onMouseLeave.summary: Adds a listener for mouseleave on the host. Returns the element.

setDisabled.summary: Sets the disabled attribute when nextValue is truthy and removes it otherwise. Returns the element.

root-class.description: Extra classes applied to the inner icon button element.
